provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the lilies work (2026-10-18): every character from the floras in the lilies notes (plantgen-claude project-files/lilies/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Lilium kelloggii, plant_name_id 279920.

growth_form.note: A bulbous herb with one leafy flowering stem a year, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown five years from seed, as a lily bulb takes three to five to flower; drawn at its third and fifth years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

allometry.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stems usually 0.6-1.2 m; FNA gives only 'stems to 2.1 m'. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 0.9 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stems usually 0.6-1.2 m; FNA gives only 'stems to 2.1 m'.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stems to 2.1 m

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves in 2-7 whorls or partial whorls (scattered and more or less proximal in dry, exposed sites)

traits.leaf_whorls.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves in 2-7 whorls. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaves_per_whorl.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): 3-22(-40) leaves per whorl. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 6-16 x 0.9-4.4 cm

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 0.9-4.4 cm wide, 2.6-8.5 times longer than wide. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): blade elliptic, usually narrowly so, often weakly oblanceolate

traits.leaf_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves drooping at tips to ascending

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): inflorescences racemose, 1-27-flowered. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.flower_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowers pendent, fragrant

traits.perianth_reflexion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): perianth Turk's-cap-shaped; sepals and petals reflexed 1/3 along length from base

traits.perianth_reflexion_from.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): reflexed 1/3 along length from base

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): pink, less often white, and if so usually aging pink The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_spots.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): usually with copious maroon spots

traits.perianth_spot_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): maroon spots The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals 3.4-7.2 cm, petals 3.2-7.1 cm

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stamens moderately exserted

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): anthers pale red-orange or magenta The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): pedicel 8.8-23.8 cm

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 2.9-5.7 x 1-1.6 cm

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 1-1.6 cm wide

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium kelloggii (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowering summer (mid Jun-early Aug)
